title: Anatomy of the Human Heart
prompt: Click the left ventricle — the chamber that pumps oxygenated blood to the body.

hotspots.label: Left ventricle
hotspots.feedback: Correct. The left ventricle has the thickest muscular wall because it pumps blood through the entire systemic circulation.

hotspots.label: Right ventricle
hotspots.feedback: That is the right ventricle. It pumps deoxygenated blood to the lungs at lower pressure.

hotspots.label: Left atrium
hotspots.feedback: That is the left atrium. It receives oxygenated blood from the lungs.

hotspots.label: Aorta
hotspots.feedback: That is the aorta — the artery that carries oxygenated blood from the left ventricle.
